THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotment of land with the names and extent mentioned below depicted in the Advance Tracing No. R/KLW/2022/787 dated 25.08.2023 made by Surveyor General, situated at Botiyathenna Village (F.V.P. 933) Uda Paththuwa Minor Division, Kalawana of Kukulu Korale, Divisional Secretary's Division of Ratnapura District of Sabaragamuwa Province, bounded as follows.
01. Lot “A” - Name of the Land - Botiyathenna Waththa - Extent: 13.3695 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 74,84, 76 1/2 and 76; East: Lot No. 76 1/2 and 76; South: Lot No. 84; West: Lot Nos. 74 and 84.
K. D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Land and Irrigation.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/23/2021/FR/214.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,08th January 2025.
